appearance.evidence: The app has no theme setting of its own; its Settings window and Ice Bar follow the system appearance (SwiftUI), so macOS dark appearance applies. Menu Bar Appearance only tints the menu bar.

features.reason: Unique and solves the notch problem on MacBooks, so it sits second.
features.shows: The Ice Bar open as a floating strip under the menu bar holding hidden items such as Slack, Dropbox, 1Password and Tailscale, with a notched-style menu bar above.

features.reason: The signature way to organise items and the clearest picture of control, third for the first-screen trio.
features.shows: The Menu Bar Layout window with Visible, Hidden and Always-Hidden rows each filled with real app tiles (Slack, Zoom, Dropbox, iTerm2, Tailscale, 1Password), one tile mid-drag.

features.reason: A daily time saver that reaches items even when hidden.
features.shows: The search panel with a query like "sl" typed and matching results (Slack, Slack Huddle helper, Sleep Timer) listed, including hidden ones.

features.reason: A visual, eye-catching feature that looks good in a picture.
features.shows: Menu Bar Appearance with a gradient tint, border and rounded shape set, with the live preview of the menu bar above the controls.

features.reason: Power-user convenience; shown as the Hotkeys screen, which is where the feature lives.
features.shows: The Hotkeys pane with real shortcuts recorded (e.g. ⌃⌥H toggle hidden section, ⌃⌥Space search, ⌃⌥B Ice Bar, ⌃⌥A application menus).
